title: DNA Quantification Using the Qubit Fluorometer
author: Nikki Freed
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfy3jpyn
materials: The instrument displays the results on the Read standard screen. For information on interpreting the calibration results, refer to the Qubit™ Fluorometer User Guide, available for download at thermofisher.com/qubit.

steps.title: Prepare Qubit working mastermix
steps.instruction: Calculate the total volume of Qubit dsDNA HS Reagent (1 µL per sample) and Qubit dsDNA HS Buffer (199 µL per sample) needed for all samples plus two calibration standards, then remove that total amount from the working‑solution bottle and dispense it into the appropriate assay tubes.

steps.title: Label assay tubes
steps.instruction: Label only the lids of thin‑wall, clear 0.5 mL PCR tubes (e.g., Qubit™ assay tubes, Cat. No. Q32856); do not label the side of the tube.

steps.title: Aliquot working solution
steps.instruction: Add 190 µL of the prepared Qubit working solution to each standard tube. For each sample tube add 180–199 µL of working solution (volume chosen so that, after sample addition, the total volume will be exactly 200 µL).

steps.title: Add standards and samples
steps.instruction: Pipette 10 µL of Standard #1 into its tube and 10 µL of Standard #2 into its tube. Then add 1–20 µL of each user sample to the corresponding sample tube; use a P‑2 pipette when adding 1–2 µL for best accuracy.

steps.title: Mix tubes
steps.instruction: Vortex each tube vigorously for 3–5 seconds to ensure complete mixing of sample/standard with the working solution.

steps.title: Incubate tubes
steps.instruction: Allow all tubes to sit at room temperature for 2 minutes before reading.

steps.title: Calibrate fluorometer (optional)
steps.instruction: On the Qubit 3 Home screen press DNA, select “1X dsDNA HS” assay, then press “Read Standards”. If a calibration for this assay already exists, you may choose to use the previous calibration and skip to step 8; otherwise continue with the following substeps.

substeps.instruction: Insert the Standard #1 tube into the sample chamber, close the lid, and press “Read standard”. Wait ~3 seconds, then remove the tube.
Insert the Standard #2 tube, close the lid, and press “Read standard”. Wait ~3 seconds, then remove the tube.

steps.title: Set assay parameters
steps.instruction: Press “Run samples”. On the assay screen select the sample volume added to each tube (1–20 µL) using the wheel buttons, and choose “ng/µL” from the unit dropdown for output concentration.

steps.title: Read each sample
steps.instruction: For each sample tube: insert the tube into the chamber, close the lid, press “Read tube”, wait ~3 seconds, then remove the tube. The large top value displayed is the original sample concentration; the bottom value is the dilution concentration.

steps.title: Record and save results
steps.instruction: Carefully record all concentration values and export the run file to a memory stick.

steps.title: Verify negative controls
steps.instruction: Confirm that each negative‑control tube reads “too low” (ideally below detection) but is not higher than 1 ng/µL; any control ≥1 ng/µL indicates contamination and requires repeating the preceding steps.
